name: TR
description: This keyword returns the True Range(TR) value of the selected Instrument for the selected timeframe. This keyword is to be used under the position keyword
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword returns the True Range(TR) value of the selected Instrument for the selected timeframe. This keyword is to be used under the position keyword

![Example](./images/img-1632224512.png)

The above keyword will return the previous day TR value of ABFRL

Read here to know more about TR - https://www.macroption.com/true-range/
